column1: Luis Arraez headlines the slate with a strong track record of consistency, hitting safely in nearly 75% of games and drawing a favorable home matchup with the platoon edge against Cristian Javier. Yandy Diaz offers similar reliability from the leadoff spot, riding a recent hot stretch and also benefiting from a platoon advantage. Cody Bellinger, Drake Baldwin, and Matt Olson all have solid hit probabilities with advantageous matchups, but Arraez and Diaz stand out for their steadiness and lineup placement.
